notes: Upstream ships two builds under this name. This is the SHIPPED one: JUMPDEST precompile, -mzisk-dma, fused cgoto dispatch. `develop` (sha dd445f3f1a093a42, commit 7e6c702) has none of them and costs 1.348x these steps over the 200-block corpus; quoting a Monad gap against it understates it by about a third. To obtain it deliberately, set source.upstream_branch and commit to that one and run build.sh --check.

Byte-reproducible: the build embeds no path strings, so elf_sha256 is checked as an equality and a mismatch means an input moved. The Monad guests cannot make that promise -- rustc stamps the build path into a .symtab symbol -- so theirs is a finding, not a contract.
